body: Puns are a challenging form of figurative language that exploit phonetic similarity and semantic ambiguity to convey multiple meanings. Although large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong language understanding capabilities, they still struggle with pun reasoning due to limited phonetic modeling and uncontrolled end-to-end generation. We propose PunGraph, a retrieval-enhanced knowledge graph framework for pun understanding. PunGraph constructs a phonetic-semantic lexical graph using the Unisyn phonetic dictionary, IPA and G2P representations, and WordNet definitions, and retrieves candidate words or senses to constrain LLM reasoning within a structured candidate space. We further introduce WebPun, a new large-scale dataset containing 5,730 annotated heterographic and homographic puns. Experiments on SemEval-2017 and WebPun show that PunGraph consistently improves the performance of small-scale LLMs and achieves competitive results against strong proprietary models. Further analysis shows that retrieval-guided phonetic and semantic constraints effectively reduce common reasoning errors in pun interpretation, highlighting the benefits of integrating structured knowledge with LLMs. We release our code and dataset at https://github.com/ysu132/PunGraph.
summaryZh: 本文提出了PunGraph框架，旨在解决大模型在处理双关语时因缺乏语音建模和端到端生成不可控导致的推理困难。该方法通过构建包含IPA、G2P及WordNet定义的语音-语义词汇图，约束大模型的推理空间。研究同时发布了包含5,730个双关语样本的WebPun数据集。实验表明，PunGraph能有效提升小规模大模型的推理性能，并减少常见逻辑错误，验证了结构化知识与大模型结合的有效性。
